UserProgress.title: User Progress
UserProgress.description: Stores the completion status of chapters, daily study session logs, and active parent share token for each user.

state.description: A map of chapter keys to boolean completion status.

studyLogs.description: Chronological list of completed Pomodoro and Stopwatch study sessions.

parentShareToken.description: Random secret token for the read-only Parent View link.

SharedProgress.title: Shared Parent Progress
SharedProgress.description: Anonymous read-only snapshot of study progress shared with parents via a secret token. Contains zero PII/email.

ownerId.description: UID of the student who owns this shared view (for write/delete rule enforcement only).

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last progress update.

overallReadiness.description: Aggregate chapters and marks completion metrics across all subjects.

subjectProgress.description: Per-subject completion and marks readiness metrics.

dailyStudyMinutes.description: Map of YYYY-MM-DD dates to total minutes studied that day.

state.description: Map of chapter keys to boolean completion status.

studyLogs.description: Sanitized study session logs for calendar and heatmap visualization.

/artifacts/upboard-checklist/users/{user.description: The private progress and study log document for a specific user.

/shared_progress/{token}.description: Publicly readable (by secret token only), owner-writable study telemetry for Parent View.
